passages.text: Again I lifted up my eyes and saw before me a flying scroll.
passages.sermon:
The prophet Zechariah looked up again.
He saw something in front of him.
He saw a scroll.
The scroll was flying.
passages.original: וָאָשׁ֕וּב וָאֶשָּׂ֥א עֵינַ֖י וָֽאֶרְאֶ֑ה וְהִנֵּ֖ה מְגִלָּ֥ה עָפָֽה׃

passages.text: “What do you see?” asked the angel. “I see a flying scroll,” I replied, “twenty cubits long and ten cubits wide.”
passages.sermon:
An angel spoke to me.
The angel asked me a question.
The angel said, “What do you see?”
I answered the angel.
I said, “I see a flying scroll.”
The scroll is twenty cubits long.
The scroll is ten cubits wide.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י מָ֥ה אַתָּ֖ה רֹאֶ֑ה וָאֹמַ֗ר אֲנִ֤י רֹאֶה֙ מְגִלָּ֣ה עָפָ֔ה אָרְכָּהּ֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה וְרָחְבָּ֖הּ עֶ֥שֶׂר בָּאַמָּֽה׃

passages.text: Then he told me, “This is the curse that is going out over the face of all the land, for according to one side of the scroll, every thief will be removed; and according to the other side, every perjurer will be removed.
passages.sermon:
The angel spoke to me.
He said, “This is the curse.”
This curse goes out over the whole land.
The scroll carries this curse.
One side of the scroll speaks against every thief.
Every thief will be removed from the land.
The other side of the scroll speaks against every person who swears falsely.
Every perjurer will be removed from the land.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י זֹ֚את הָֽאָלָ֔ה הַיּוֹצֵ֖את עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י כָל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּ֣י כָל־ הַגֹּנֵ֗ב מִזֶּה֙ כָּמ֣וֹהָ נִקָּ֔ה וְכָל־ הַנִּ֨שְׁבָּ֔ע מִזֶּ֖ה כָּמ֥וֹהָ נִקָּֽה׃

passages.text: I will send it out, declares the LORD of Hosts, and it will enter the house of the thief and the house of him who swears falsely by My name. It will remain inside his house and destroy it, down to its timbers and stones.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
He says, “I will send out the curse.”
The curse will enter the house of the thief.
The curse will also enter the house of the person who swears falsely by My name.
The curse will stay inside that house.
The curse will destroy the house completely.
It will destroy the wood and the stones of the house.
passages.original: הוֹצֵאתִ֗יהָ נְאֻם֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וּבָ֙אָה֙ אֶל־ בֵּ֣ית הַגַּנָּ֔ב וְאֶל־ בֵּ֛ית הַנִּשְׁבָּ֥ע בִּשְׁמִ֖י לַשָּׁ֑קֶר וְלָ֙נֶה֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ בֵּית֔וֹ וְכִלַּ֖תּוּ וְאֶת־ עֵצָ֥יו וְאֶת־ אֲבָנָֽיו׃

passages.text: Then the angel who was speaking with me came forward and told me, “Now lift up your eyes and see what is approaching.”
passages.sermon:
An angel spoke with me.
This angel came forward to me.
The angel told me something.
He said, “Lift up your eyes now.
See what is coming.”
passages.original: וַיֵּצֵ֕א הַמַּלְאָ֖ךְ הַדֹּבֵ֣ר בִּ֑י וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י שָׂ֣א נָ֤א עֵינֶ֙יךָ֙ וּרְאֵ֔ה מָ֖ה הַיּוֹצֵ֥את הַזֹּֽאת׃

passages.text: “What is it?” I asked. And he replied, “A measuring basket is going forth.” Then he continued, “This is their iniquity in all the land.”
passages.sermon:
The prophet Zechariah saw a vision from God.
Zechariah asked, “What is it?”
The angel answered Zechariah.
The angel said, “A measuring basket is going forth.”
The angel explained the meaning.
The angel said, “This basket is their iniquity in all the land.”
passages.original: וָאֹמַ֖ר מַה־ הִ֑יא וַיֹּ֗אמֶר זֹ֤את הָֽאֵיפָה֙ הַיּוֹצֵ֔את וַיֹּ֕אמֶר זֹ֥את עֵינָ֖ם בְּכָל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: And behold, the cover of lead was raised, and there was a woman sitting inside the basket.
passages.sermon:
A lead cover was lifted up.
A woman sat inside the basket.
The basket was called an ephah.
The angel showed this to Zechariah.
passages.original: וְהִנֵּ֛ה כִּכַּ֥ר עֹפֶ֖רֶת נִשֵּׂ֑את וְזֹאת֙ אִשָּׁ֣ה אַחַ֔ת יוֹשֶׁ֖בֶת בְּת֥וֹךְ הָאֵיפָֽה׃

passages.text: “This is Wickedness,” he said. And he shoved her down into the basket, pushing down the lead cover over its opening.
passages.sermon:
The angel spoke to me.
He said, “This is Wickedness.”
A woman sat inside the basket.
The angel forced the woman down into the basket.
He pushed her into the basket.
He placed the heavy lead cover over the basket’s opening.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ זֹ֣את הָרִשְׁעָ֔ה וַיַּשְׁלֵ֥ךְ אֹתָ֖הּ אֶל־ תּ֣וֹךְ הָֽאֵיפָ֑ה וַיַּשְׁלֵ֛ךְ אֶת־ אֶ֥בֶן הָעֹפֶ֖רֶת אֶל־ פִּֽיהָ׃ס

passages.text: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw two women approaching, with the wind in their wings. Their wings were like those of a stork, and they lifted up the basket between heaven and earth.
passages.sermon:
The prophet Zechariah looked up.
He saw two women coming forward.
The women had wings.
The wind filled their wings.
Their wings looked like stork wings.
The women lifted the basket.
They carried the basket between earth and heaven.
passages.original: וָאֶשָּׂ֨א עֵינַ֜י וָאֵ֗רֶא וְהִנֵּה֩ שְׁתַּ֨יִם נָשִׁ֤ים יֽוֹצְאוֹת֙ וְר֣וּחַ בְּכַנְפֵיהֶ֔ם וְלָהֵ֥נָּה כְנָפַ֖יִם כְּכַנְפֵ֣י הַחֲסִידָ֑ה וַתִּשֶּׂ֙אנָה֙ אֶת־ הָ֣אֵיפָ֔ה בֵּ֥ין הָאָ֖רֶץ וּבֵ֥ין הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃

passages.text: “Where are they taking the basket?” I asked the angel who was speaking with me.
passages.sermon:
The prophet Zechariah saw a vision.
Zechariah saw two women carrying a basket.
Zechariah spoke to an angel.
The angel was talking with Zechariah.
Zechariah asked the angel a question.
Zechariah said, “Where are they taking the basket?”
passages.original: וָאֹמַ֕ר אֶל־ הַמַּלְאָ֖ךְ הַדֹּבֵ֣ר בִּ֑י אָ֛נָה הֵ֥מָּה מֽוֹלִכ֖וֹת אֶת־ הָאֵיפָֽה׃

passages.text: “To build a house for it in the land of Shinar,” he told me. “And when it is ready, the basket will be set there on its pedestal.”
passages.sermon:
The angel spoke to me.
He said, “They will build a house for the basket.
They will build it in the land of Shinar.
When the house is ready, they will place the basket there.
They will set it on its pedestal.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י לִבְנֽוֹת־ לָ֥הֿ בַ֖יִת בְּאֶ֣רֶץ שִׁנְעָ֑ר וְהוּכַ֛ן וְהֻנִּ֥יחָה שָּׁ֖ם עַל־ מְכֻנָתָֽהּ׃ס
